title: MEIKO — Heat's My Game〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I had no idea that Honami and the girls were in such a pickle.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I was a little surprised too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad that our band is receiving so many offers, of course...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm struggling to make a decision on what to do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It is a tough one. Especially since their solo show and the Fan Festival are both equally important to them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think we came at the perfect time. I mean, Hona seemed so lost.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I'm glad she was able to talk it out with us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
She seemed to be feeling a little better when we left...
So, I'm sure she'll be okay.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We need to keep providing them with all the support we can so that they can focus on their show.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right! But what can we do, specifically?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Well...
What if we cleaned this classroom?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll be spending much more time here to practice and hold planning meetings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wouldn't it be easier to maintain your concentration when the classroom you're in is nice and clean?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! And they'd probably feel more motivated!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, let's make everything so sparkly clean that they won't believe their eyes☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Okay, I've finished wiping down all the desks. Now I just need to clean the windows with Rin.)

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: MEIKO, help!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm trying to clean the top part of the blackboard, but I can't reach it without jumping...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha. I see.
In that case, why don't I lift you up so you can do it?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, don't treat me like a little kid!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm joking. Sit tight while I go get you a chair.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll wipe the floors by starting on this end and working our way down the grain on the floorboards.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay!
While we're at it, we should have a race to see who gets to the other side first!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're on. I won't be holding back.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not about to let you win either!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, on your marks, get set... Go!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Humhumm♪ The classroom's so sparkly now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure Honami and the others will be so surprised.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, Rin, MEIKO.
We're thinking about playing a song together...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? This classroom looks really clean for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, you noticed?
MEIKO and I just gave it really nice clean!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This is incredible. Even the windows and floors are sparkling.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But what made you two want to clean it all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We were actually talking about Honami and the others earlier. Despite having a lot going on right now, they're doing everything they can to keep at it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So we got to thinking about what we could do for them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Based on your logic, if we were to clean more rooms, then they'll be even happier. So, why don't we take this opportunity to do some cleaning ourselves?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, let's all clean together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, today can be SEKAI cleanup day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's make the corridors and classrooms so clean that Honami and the others won't believe their eyes!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!
